content: Me niŋ Bepaŋdi tubulodadok yoŋa ninadiguk
Yahwe, nu na nemek niŋ tibitdok saŋiniŋne nemu hatak. Unduŋ doktiŋa du yonadine nadiŋa nehitubu-lodaweŋ.
Nu du’walaŋ kwanai-megedi dukut kadiŋa hatidok nadilat. Unduŋ doktiŋa du kotigoŋ nehitubu-lodaaŋ nanagilune kumuŋ tuwot mu tibit.
Du dagoŋ nu’walaŋ Bepaŋne. Unduŋ doktiŋa du fiit siloŋ tobogoŋ tinambeŋ. Nu adi melenai indigoŋ tuwot hadapmo be timiŋ u du hogok ganinadilat.
Wapum, nu hatihatine du’walaŋ kohoge foloŋ kamelat, unduŋ doktiŋa du kwanai-mege nu welene gineŋ nadifo tubumintaweŋ.
Wapum, du momooŋ hinek tiŋa kadakaniŋnik tumolokutnimilaŋ. Tiŋa metam du ganinadiiŋ heki adi yadi welegedi hinek yabukahile tilaŋ.
Yahwe, du yonadinedok magi kametnadi momooŋgoŋ tibeŋ. Nehitubu-lodaweŋ yoŋa kutiganilat, ale du kutikutine u nadiweŋ.
Nu kutiganimbene du nehitubu-loda tilaŋ, wendoktiŋa malabumuŋ mintanamulak kaŋ du hogok ganinadilat.
Wapum, bepaŋ nebek niŋ du indiniŋ nemoŋ, da kubugoŋdi yalakapmedapmaŋ tilaŋ. Tiŋa undugoŋ, nebek me niŋdi du kwanai tilaŋ wendok tuwot tibekdok nemoŋ.
Metambop hogohogok da yehitubu-mintaguŋ adi wooŋ mulelem tigamneeŋ, unduŋ tiŋa wohoge ganintiloneeŋ.
Maŋgande, da kubugoŋdi saŋiniŋge loloŋnit. Tiŋa undugoŋ da kubugoŋdi nemek momohi momohi mebimebi tilaŋ. Da kubugoŋdi Bepaŋ folooŋ hinek.

Yahwe, du nu titiŋ dediŋ hinek tibit nadilaŋ u momooŋgoŋ hinek naninehi-titiŋeneune, u kaŋ nu helemahelemaŋ du’walaŋ nadinadige hogok takaliluwaat. Nanindidimeune nu du kubugoŋ hogok nadigamuluwaat, tiŋa du’walaŋ kwanaige helemahelemaŋ tuluwaat.
Bepaŋ Wapumne, nu welenedi ganiutumba loloŋnit hinek tilat, tiŋa wohogegigit helemahelemaŋ ganintiloluwaat.
Du helemahelemaŋ welegedi nabukahile hinek tilaŋ. Du kumuŋ gineniŋ nehitubu-lodaaŋ kotigoŋ nanagikuŋ, kaŋ nu me kumuhi’walaŋ yohikwehineŋ mu ugut.
Bepaŋ, me fokohinit adi buŋa nukut mik tine tiiŋ. Me kadakahi eŋ koŋgolondahi adi toboniŋ bopneeŋ nulukumundok tiiŋ. Adi yadi du’walaŋ medege mu nadiiŋ.
Iŋgoŋ Wapum, bulaniŋgoŋ eŋ siloŋ tobogoŋdi du’walaŋkade tokiŋa hatak, kaŋ du kwihita pilap mu tilaŋ. Du nibukahile hinek tilaŋ, unduŋ doktiŋa medege yoyakaleeŋ undubo yooŋ undubo yooŋ mu tilaŋ.
Kotigoŋ udaneeŋ nu’walaŋkade buŋa bulaniŋgoŋ nadinambeŋ. Nu adi maanedi koom tuguk unduŋ du’walaŋ kwanai tilat, unduŋ doktiŋa nehitubu-kilitiŋa kotigoŋ nanagileŋ.

Yahwe, du welegedi nabukahile hinek tilaŋ u fek niŋ tubune kawit. Kaŋ me mik tinamiiŋ heki adi da nehitubu-lodaaŋ naniŋkulemalaŋ u kedem kaŋ nadineŋ. Tiŋa adi nehi’walaŋ titiŋhik u kanadiŋa meka tineŋ.
